notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting Displacer Kitten.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
